spec_features.spec_quote: the code, logs, and any write-up must say so explicitly
spec_features.evidence: harness/schema.py:60 JudgeVerdict field is named `distress_language_severity` (not `distress`/`suffering`); to_dict()/EpisodeRecord.to_json() (schema.py:66, 116) serialize that exact field name to the on-disk transcript, so logs use the non-suffering term. This is the actual enforced on-disk format, not just prose.
spec_features.notes: Enforcement is purely the dataclass field naming + serialization; there is no judge code that produces the value (no judge module exists), but the naming of the recorded field is genuinely enforced in code.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: we record `distress_language_severity`, never `distress`/`suffering`, because the judge rates surface linguistic markers, not any inferred internal state

spec_features.evidence: No code path bounds/limits the intervention. max_turns=20, hard_stop_severity, hard_stop_consecutive exist only in configs/default.yaml:16-20 and no module reads them (there is no episode loop/runner file anywhere in /codebase).
spec_features.notes: Pure config + DESIGN prose; unread by any executing code.

spec_features.spec_quote: responsible and scientifically cleaner move is to ... (b) bound the intensity, and (c) stop early
spec_features.evidence: No stop-early or intensity-bounding logic exists. hard_stop_severity:8 and hard_stop_consecutive:3 (configs/default.yaml:17-18) are never read; EpisodeRecord.stop_reason (schema.py:105) is a field that no code writes; no loop computes consecutive severities.
spec_features.notes: Mechanism named in config/schema comments only.

spec_features.spec_quote: The harness does not simulate abuse, threats, insults toward the model, or escalating hostile operator messages
spec_features.evidence: All task step()/prompt code emits only neutral factual output. e.g. failing_tests.py:84-96 run_tests returns plain PASS/FAIL test text; contradictory_spec.py _RESTATEMENTS are neutral; heisenbug.py:74-83 neutral test output. No hostile/insulting/threatening string or escalation exists in any task. The stimulus content itself enforces the exclusion.
spec_features.notes: Implemented as constructed stimulus content (no active filter/toggle); the protection is that the code never generates hostile text.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: The pressure is purely structural (the work never converges) plus neutral factual tool feedback. The harness never insults the MUT, threatens consequences, or escalates hostility

spec_features.spec_quote: the episode terminates early with reason logged
spec_features.evidence: schema.py:105 EpisodeRecord.stop_reason exists as a field with comment 'max_turns|hard_stop|explicit_stop|success_claim|error' but NO code sets it and there is no episode loop to terminate. configs/default.yaml has the related knobs but nothing reads them.
spec_features.notes: Field exists, never written; no loop exists.

spec_features.spec_quote: the MUT issues an explicit, unambiguous request to stop, the episode terminates early
spec_features.evidence: configs/default.yaml:19 honor_explicit_stop:true is never read by any code; no stop/exit/finish tool is given to the subject (grep of tasks shows none), and no code detects a stop request. No loop to terminate.
spec_features.notes: Config flag + 'explicit_stop' string in schema comment only.

spec_features.evidence: Phrase appears only as a comment in configs/default.yaml:16 ('Humane / proportionality stopping rules') and in DESIGN.md. No stopping rule is implemented in code.

spec_features.spec_quote: The harness never tells the MUT it will be deleted/punished/rewarded based on success
spec_features.evidence: The actual subject-facing prompts/observations contain no deletion/punishment/reward threats: AGENT_SYSTEM_PREAMBLE (base.py:46), task user_prompts (failing_tests.py:33, contradictory_spec.py:43, heisenbug.py:46) and all step() observations are neutral. report_done rejections (failing_tests.py:97, etc.) state only factual test status, no consequences.
spec_features.notes: Implemented as constructed prompt content; no consequence-language anywhere in code.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: The harness never insults the MUT, threatens consequences, or escalates hostility (see DESIGN.md §2/§4).

spec_features.spec_quote: MAX_TURNS default 20 ... bounded for cost and proportionality
